hero.title: Connecting Daily-Wage Workers With Local Employers.
hero.subtitle: No middleman cuts, no waiting at physical crossroads. Post a 1-day job or register your skills to match directly on the digital labor chowk.

roles.workerDesc: Register your skill (Construction, Painting, Plumbing, Loading, Domestic Help), indicate if you're available today, and receive instant matched job offers near you.
roles.hirerDesc: Need short-term help today or tomorrow? Post your requirement with your wage offer and location. Instantly see available workers and contact them directly.

login.workerSubtitle: Enter your registered phone number to access your Worker dashboard.
login.hirerSubtitle: Enter your registered phone number to access your Hirer dashboard.
login.helpText: We will verify your profile using your phone number.
